(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and each of the flanges being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the adhesive comprises an epoxy-based adhesive.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas and into interfacial layers between the members.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other at points outside the radius areas.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges, the structure including a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of composite fabric joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
